fusions.name: Herald of the Route
fusions.desc: A thrown call that deals 30 damage and hits harder the further it travels, up to 2 times its damage at maximum range. Its reach is 50% longer. When it hits, every ally strikes 20% harder for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Wake Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks a short wave ahead of you, dealing 4 damage to everything in the cone. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you run before using it (max +30%). Each hit has a 25% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Measured Breathing
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 10 seconds. Its effect increases by 9% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Migratory Stride
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.
